name: Holy Symbol (choose form)
operation_language: Authoring intent only; not registered engine syntax.

rules.text: A Holy Symbol takes one of the listed forms: Amulet (worn or held), Emblem (borne on fabric or a Shield), Reliquary (held). Cleric or Paladin can use it as a focus. Each costs 5 GP; weights are 1 pound, unspecified and 2 pounds respectively.

definition.name: Holy Symbol
definition.description: An amulet representing a deity or pantheon, usable as a Cleric spellcasting focus.

unsupported_behavior.requirement: Resolve form/tool choices and grant exactly once. Monk/Soldier copy matches chosen proficiency; Bard instrument choice remains independent. Generic Holy Symbol seed must not silently force Amulet.

Map class-owned focus permission, free hands, Material costs/consumption and Holy Symbol held/worn/borne forms. Staff is one exact copy with both Quarterstaff and focus roles; existing tool-only staff seeds do not provide the weapon role.

reconciliation_note: Seed description forces an amulet; source package leaves form open.
